mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; tolterodine exhibits antimuscarinic activity while guanfacine is an alpha-2 agonist, and their combined effects may enhance sedation, dizziness, and anticholinergic adverse effects.
action: Monitor patients for increased CNS depression, dry mouth, constipation, and urinary retention; consider dose adjustment or alternative agent if excessive anticholinergic effects or sedation occur.
